settings.heading: The quiet ritual of home.
settings.subheading: How a small Portland studio became a practice in mindful living.

settings.heading: Our Story
settings.body:
We started Aura & Oak in a converted garage in Portland with one candle — Amber & Oakmoss — and a belief that the things we smell every day should be made with as much care as the things we eat and the things we read.

Seven years later, we're still a small studio, still pouring by hand, still obsessed with the way a scent can make a room feel like home.
settings.value_text_1: Every candle poured by hand in our Portland studio.
settings.value_text_2: 100% soy wax, phthalate-free fragrances, cotton wicks.
settings.value_text_3: Refillable vessels, recyclable packaging, carbon-neutral shipping.
settings.value_text_4: Supporting local artisans and makers in the Pacific Northwest.
